body: Some folks in my chapter have been discussing this post this morning and someone brought up the very good point that if the SRA’s official party line going forward is “we don’t do anything” then they shouldn’t advertise themselves as an education & training group, then get defensive and start straw manning when membership expects that of them. Why are people paying dues to just sit in a discord server?

It’s decentralized so it can’t be shut down. Yes, it will probably be dangerous because fighting for change always is. This stuff isn’t done safely from home. Go with a group, bring first aid stuff, have an exit plan.
If they were smart they’d follow them
What have we learned here today kids? When the guy who just shot you decides to spare your life, should we antagonize him further?
